name: pharmacy-pos
description: Pharmacy POS & Management System - Full Stack

scripts.dev: npm run db:start && concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix pharmacy-pos-backend run dev" "npm --prefix pharmacy-pos-frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run db:start && npm --prefix pharmacy-pos-backend run dev
scripts.db:start: powershell -Command "if (-not (Get-Process mysqld -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysqld.exe' -ArgumentList '--defaults-file=C:\xampp\mysql\bin\my.ini','--standalone' -WorkingDirectory 'C:\xampp' -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Write-Host '🟢 MySQL (XAMPP) started successfully.' } else { Write-Host '🟢 MySQL is already running.' }"
scripts.db:stop: powershell -Command "C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysqladmin.exe -u root shutdown -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host '🔴 MySQL (XAMPP) stopped.'"
scripts.build: npm --prefix pharmacy-pos-backend run build && npm --prefix pharmacy-pos-frontend run build
scripts.seed: npm run db:start && npm --prefix pharmacy-pos-backend run seed
